scope: All 41 non-cafe POIs in the source dataset
method: Reviewed 623-file Commons geographic discovery candidate list; proximity not accepted as identity
Queried named Commons categories and specific known file titles; captured imageinfo/extmetadata and category warnings
Targeted Commons web searches in Russian, English and Kazakh
Visually reviewed 29 candidate thumbnails; selected additions have exact name/category identity
Did not copy arbitrary commercial map listings, generate fake photos, or assign unrelated nearby places
